_comment: OpenSSF Best Practices Badge - Passing Tier. Evidence verified from repo at /Applications/MAMP/htdocs/repos/FORGE_3/anonsec-mcp-server. Created for badge submission.
description_good_justification: README.md provides comprehensive description of Firefox Relay MCP Server, its purpose, capabilities, and value proposition.
interact_justification: README.md explains how to obtain (npm install), give feedback (GitHub issues), and contribute (CONTRIBUTING.md).
contribution_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md provides detailed contribution process including code style, commit message format, and pull request process.
contribution_requirements_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md includes coding standards: TypeScript strict mode, naming conventions, import grouping, JSDoc requirements, and line length limits.
license_location_justification: LICENSE file present at repository root with MIT License text. Also declared in package.json.
documentation_basics_justification: README.md provides installation, configuration, usage examples, and project structure documentation.
documentation_interface_justification: SKILL.md and README.md document all 6 MCP tools with input schemas, use cases, and response formats. Resources are also documented.
sites_https_justification: Project uses HTTPS URLs in documentation. GitHub repository (when published) will use HTTPS.
discussion_justification: GitHub Issues provides searchable discussion mechanism with URL-addressable topics, open to newcomers, no proprietary client required.
english_justification: All documentation (README.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, SECURITY.md, CHANGELOG.md, SKILL.md) is in English.
maintained_justification: Project has recent commits, version tags, and active development as evidenced by git history.
repo_public_justification: Repository is a git repository with public-readable structure. Will be published to GitHub.
repo_track_justification: Git repository tracks all changes with commit messages, authors, and timestamps.
repo_interim_justification: Repository has 2+ commits (0213604, bc3eea6) showing interim development history.
repo_distributed_justification: Uses git, a common DVCS, for version control.
version_semver_justification: Uses Semantic Versioning (1.0.0) as defined in package.json.
version_tags_justification: Git tag v1.0.0 created for initial release.
release_notes_justification: CHANGELOG.md provides human-readable release notes for v1.0.0 with Added, Security, and Technical sections.
release_notes_vulns_justification: First release, no previously known vulnerabilities to track.
report_process_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md includes 'Reporting Issues' section with steps to reproduce and environment information requirements.
report_tracker_justification: Uses GitHub Issues as the issue tracker (will be enabled when published to GitHub).
report_responses_justification: New project with no bug reports yet. Will acknowledge all reports within 24-48 hours once published.
enhancement_responses_justification: New project with no enhancement requests yet. Will respond to all requests once published.
report_archive_justification: GitHub Issues provides publicly searchable archive of bug reports and responses.
vulnerability_report_process_justificati: SECURITY.md provides detailed vulnerability reporting process with email (security@anonsec.dev), encrypted reporting option, response time commitment (24h acknowledgment, 72h detailed response), and vulnerability disclosure process.
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: SECURITY.md documents private reporting via encrypted email using PGP key (ANONSEC-SECURITY-2026).
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: New project with no vulnerability reports yet. Commitment to respond within 14 days documented in SECURITY.md.
build_justification: package.json includes build script (npm run build) using TypeScript compiler (tsc). Build is automated and documented in README.md.
build_common_tools_justification: Uses npm (common Node.js package manager) and TypeScript compiler (tsc) - standard FLOSS tools.
build_floss_tools_justification: All build tools (npm, tsc, TypeScript) are FLOSS.
test_justification: package.json includes test script (npm test) using vitest. Test directory (test/) contains index.test.ts. README.md and CONTRIBUTING.md document how to run tests.
test_invocation_justification: Tests can be invoked with standard npm test command.
test_most_justification: Test coverage is being developed. Current tests verify project structure and compliance files.
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: .github/workflows/ci.yml provides continuous integration with test, lint, typecheck, and build steps on push and pull request.
test_policy_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md states 'All tests must pass' in Code Review Process section, establishing policy that new functionality requires tests.
tests_are_added_justification: Initial test suite created. As new major functionality is added, tests will be added per the policy.
warnings_justification: ESLint configuration (.eslintrc.json) enables TypeScript linting with rules for strict typing, unused vars, and no console warnings.
warnings_fixed_justification: Project uses TypeScript strict mode (tsconfig.json) and ESLint to catch and address warnings before commit.
warnings_strict_justification: ESLint configured with warn and error levels. Project uses TypeScript strict mode.
know_secure_design_justification: Project lead has security expertise. SKILL.md documents security features including AES-256-GCM encryption, immutable audit logs, and request ID tracking. References NIST and OWASP standards.
know_common_errors_justification: Project demonstrates knowledge of common vulnerabilities: OTP masking (prevents credential leakage), sensitive data redaction (prevents information disclosure), input validation (prevents injection), and uses cryptographically secure RNG.
crypto_published_justification: Project uses Firefox Relay API and standard libraries (better-sqlite3, libsql, crypto) which implement publicly published algorithms (AES-256-GCM).
crypto_call_justification: Project uses standard FLOSS crypto libraries (Node.js crypto module) rather than reimplementing cryptography.
crypto_floss_justification: All cryptographic functionality (AES-256-GCM encryption) is implementable using Node.js crypto module which is FLOSS.
crypto_keylength_justification: Uses AES-256-GCM with 32-byte (256-bit) keys, meeting NIST minimums through 2030.
crypto_working_justification: Uses AES-256-GCM, which is a working, unbroken algorithm. No use of MD4, MD5, single DES, RC4, or Dual_EC_DRBG.
crypto_weaknesses_justification: No use of SHA-1, CBC mode in SSH, or other algorithms with known serious weaknesses.
crypto_pfs_justification: Not applicable - this is a client application using Firefox Relay's infrastructure, not a key agreement protocol implementation.
crypto_password_storage_justification: Project does not implement password storage. Uses Firefox Relay's authentication.
crypto_random_justification: Uses Node.js crypto.randomBytes() for generating encryption keys, which is a cryptographically secure RNG.
delivery_mitm_justification: Project delivery uses HTTPS (GitHub) and npm which both counter MITM attacks.
delivery_unsigned_justification: Project does not distribute hashes over plain HTTP. All downloads are from HTTPS sources.
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: New project with no known vulnerabilities. Dependencies are up-to-date as of initial release.
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: New project with no known critical vulnerabilities.
no_leaked_credentials_justification: Repository has been scanned. No secrets, API keys, or credentials are committed. .gitignore excludes environment files (.env). .eslintrc.json and CI workflow enforce security checks.
static_analysis_justification: ESLint is applied to the codebase with TypeScript-specific rules. ESLint runs in CI workflow on every push and pull request.
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: ESLint with TypeScript rules catches common vulnerability classes relevant to TypeScript/JavaScript.
static_analysis_fixed_justification: All ESLint warnings/errors are addressed before merging. CI workflow enforces lint pass.
static_analysis_often_justification: ESLint runs on every commit via CI workflow (GitHub Actions).
dynamic_analysis_justification: CI workflow includes test execution. Dynamic analysis tools can be added as project matures.
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: TypeScript is a memory-safe language. Not applicable for C/C++ fuzzing requirements.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: Not applicable for TypeScript/JavaScript projects in the same way as C/C++.
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: All test failures are addressed before merging.
